Workflow

Alumni and recruiting

Historic scholarship recipients are resolved to people on the register and reconnected with consent. Nothing links itself; every link is recorded and reversible.

Built in the Hub
Partly built The match queue is built (slice 9). Import, tree tracing, campaigns and the claim path are later slices.
Branches
Education Leadership
Shared services
Membership and standing, Family tree, Directory and communications
Governed by
D36 · S7

Steps

  1. Import a historic recipient listProgramme staff
  2. Resolve imported recipients through the matcher; review the band by handMatch-queue reviewer
  3. Trace an unreachable alumnus through the family treeProgramme staff
  4. Segment and run a reconnection campaign, consent-filteredProgramme staff
  5. Claim the record and joinAlumnus
  6. Ask not to be contacted; every path closesAlumnus

Hands off to

  • alumni → join: an alumnus who claims their record can join (UC-7)
  • alumni → comms: reconnection runs through the consent filter like every send

Programmes that use it

Scholarship · Ramallah Business & Professional Network
